newsitem.title: UK: UK MO falls to 25.526 bln stg in week to July 30.
newsitem.headline: UK MO falls to 25.526 bln stg in week to July 30.

text.p: British M0 money supply fell to a provisional seasonally adjusted 25.526 billion stg in the week to July 30 from 25.571 billion the previous week, the Bank of England said on Monday.
On an unadjusted basis, M0 rose to 25.853 billion stg from 25.764 billion.

Notes and coins in circulation fell to 25.360 billion stg on a seasonally adjusted basis from 25.387 billion the week before and rose to 25.687 billion from 25.580 billion stg on an unadjusted basis. -- London Newsroom 44 171 542 7715
